INT. POOLS OF CREATION - DAY 

TRANSITION DOWN as we see AKARAT lead a new follower for the next ritual.

Suddenly, Akarat looks up, eyes cutting towards the camera. They're tender and warm, even as they film over with red. 

Darkness swallows the room and its crowd. We're in a MINDSCAPE again, but this one is empty and silent. Only Akarat remains.

TENDRILS from below COIL around the Player's legs. Instead of pulling in as they had with Lorath, these hold them in place. 

Mephisto walks closer, unhurried in his approach.

As he closes in, the Player sees the opportunity to strike him and the vision down. 

CLOSE-UP on Player's hand tightening around the Spear of Light as it trembles with power.  

They lift the blade, ready to bury it in the Lord of Hatred’s chest.

But the killing blow is not struck. The Player's body tenses, and instead, we PAN UP and see the their eyes squeeze shut. 

The vision's manipulation eases. We can hear the chamber again. Directly behind, FOOTSTEPS approach, growing closer by the moment.  

The Player turns the dagger inward, towards themselves. 

We see the strike, swift and sure, but not where it lands. 

REVEAL Player back at the Pools. All SFX RETURN.

Where Mephisto had been, an ordinary follower stands instead. They point at something behind the Player and scream in horror.  

Player turns to see Akarat standing behind them, frozen. The Spear of Light sits lodged in his side. 

His hand trembles as he reaches for the hilt. Not with fear, but with rage. He TEARS OUT the dagger and tosses it aside.
Black encroaches over his eyes, an opaque and sinister film.
